body:
S206-53 closed: real cross-platform CI now succeeds end to end. Fixed the bazel test job (bare "bazel test //..." was trying to build SDL2/GL-dependent binaries the bare CI runner had no dev headers for -- fixed with --build_tests_only). Spent five failed runs debugging a macOS build that never got past the client compile step, surfacing three real GitHub Actions gotchas along the way (sdl2-config PATH assumptions, set -u silently killing a diagnostic wrapper via cross-step $GITHUB_ENV propagation, and finally GitHub's own implicit "-e" on every shell:bash step swallowing captured diagnostics) before the founder made the real call to drop macOS entirely rather than keep burning cycles on an unverifiable target. Repaired the dangling build_macos references the founder's own removal commit left behind. Final run (0de8563) passed all four jobs and cut a real first GitHub Release: v0.1.0, with papercraft-linux-x86_64.tar.gz and papercraft-windows-x86_64.zip as real downloadable assets.

⚓ ☃
title: S206-53: cross-platform CI succeeds end to end, v0.1.0 released
